reason: My wife takes the calls in the office and I ring people back in the evening, that has worked for twenty-odd years. We have more work than we can do already, so I don't see what 99 euros a month buys me.
objection: I don't believe I'm losing jobs, and I don't want two young lads with no customers sending WhatsApps to my regulars in my name. My customers want a person, not a text from a machine.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 14-day check showed in black and white that real new customers rang, never got through and never called again, enough jobs to cover the fee many times over, I might try the 30 free days.
